residency.test: More than 183 days in any 12-month period, or having a home in Portugal on any day of that period in circumstances suggesting you intend to keep it as your habitual residence.
residency.ifici: The former non-habitual resident regime closed to new entrants. Its replacement, IFICI (the incentive for scientific research and innovation), gives a 20% flat rate on qualifying Portuguese employment income and exempts most foreign income for ten years, but only for a narrow list of qualifying activities.
residency.irs_jovem: Young workers up to age 35 get a large, tapering exemption on employment income for ten years.

headline.flat_rates: 28% on most investment income, with an option to aggregate

income_tax.name: IRS
income_tax.note: married couples may elect joint taxation, which applies the quotient conjugal

married_joint.note: elective joint taxation divides income by two

standard_deduction.name: Dedução específica (categoria A)
standard_deduction.note: the higher of 4,104 and the social security contributions actually paid; 4,350 reflects the 2025 uplift

self_employed.name: Segurança Social (trabalhador independente)
self_employed.note: charged on 70% of services income, giving an effective rate of about 15%

capital_gains.securities: 28% flat rate, or elect aggregation with other income; only 50% of gains on small and medium company shares are taxed
capital_gains.real_estate: 50% of the gain is added to income and taxed at scale rates for residents
capital_gains.principal_residence: exempt if reinvested in another main home in the EU/EEA within 36 months, or for taxpayers over 65 reinvesting in a pension product
capital_gains.crypto: 28% on disposals of assets held less than 365 days; longer holdings of most tokens are exempt

quirks: The NHR regime is closed to new arrivals. IFICI is much narrower - it requires a qualifying highly skilled activity, and most retirees and remote workers no longer qualify for anything special.
IRS Jovem is generous and often overlooked: in the first year the exemption covers 100% of employment income up to a ceiling, tapering across ten years.

Deductions depend on invoices being issued with your NIF. Requesting the NIF on every restaurant, health and education receipt through the year is what actually generates the deduction, and it cannot be reconstructed afterwards.
Married couples choose each year between separate and joint taxation. Joint filing helps when incomes are very unequal and hurts when they are similar.
Social security for the self-employed is recalculated quarterly from declared income, not annually.

reporting.who_must_file: All residents, with limited exemptions for those whose only income is employment or pension income below 8,500 taxed at source.

deadlines.what: Modelo 3 IRS return for 2025 - the window is the same for all income types
Confirm household composition and dependants in the portal
Validate pending invoices (e-fatura) so deductions are counted
Payments on account for business and professional income

documents_to_collect: NIF (número de identificação fiscal) and portal password
e-fatura validated invoices for health, education, housing and general family expenses
Rent receipts or mortgage interest statement
Foreign income and foreign tax certificates for Anexo J
Details of foreign bank accounts - IBANs must be reported

penalties.late_payment: 30% to 100% of the tax due, plus interest at about 4% a year
penalties.omitted_foreign_accounts: specific penalties apply for failing to report foreign account IBANs

warnings: IRS Jovem and IFICI are not modelled. If either applies the result will be materially lower.
Expense-based deductions (health, education, housing) depend on validated e-fatura data and are not included.
Madeira and the Azores apply reduced rates that are not reflected here.
